title: Agent manifest
description: ADR-001 §6.2. What a token proves is possession of a credential bound to *this* manifest — not which model, prompt or human was behind a call (ADR §5.0, threat model).

mcp_client_id.description: How the broker names this agent in the ledger. It is a label, never a credential: a self-asserted client id is never trusted (ADR §5.0), and the broker derives identity from the presented token alone.

channel.description: Where requires_approval prompts go. Must be independent of the requesting runtime, or approval degrades from authorization to friction (threat model, known weak points).

allOf.description: ADR §6: config.apply: requires_approval requires an approvals channel. Expressible here, so it is enforced here as well as in the broker.
